description: Rory moves toward graduation and Yale as her relationships with Jess, Dean and Lorelai become more complicated and the next stage of her life stops feeling theoretical.

s03e01.description: Rory returns from Washington still drawn to Jess, only to find him with Shane, while Lorelai struggles with Christopher’s absence and has an unexpectedly domestic dream about Luke.

s03e02.description: Christopher arrives at Friday dinner and clashes with Lorelai and Rory, while Rory and Jess expose their mutual hurt over the summer and Francie begins pressuring the student council.

s03e03.description: Rory’s Harvard application triggers a wave of college anxiety, Dean questions what their future will look like after graduation, and Lane begins assembling a band.

s03e04.description: Lorelai’s talk at Stars Hollow High is derailed by questions about her teenage pregnancy, while Lane briefly dyes her hair in an act of rebellion and Rory’s hostility toward Shane grows.

s03e05.description: Emily pushes Lorelai toward a socially suitable man after a promising meeting turns into a bad date, while Jess helps Rory stop a runaway sprinkler at a neighbor’s house.

s03e06.description: Lorelai reluctantly attends Sherry’s baby shower with Rory, while Jess returns with a car that makes Luke suspicious about how he paid for it.

s03e07.description: During the Stars Hollow dance marathon, Dean finally accepts that Rory is in love with Jess and ends their relationship on the dance floor.

s03e08.description: Rory and Jess begin dating under Luke’s rules, while Richard takes the family to Yale and surprises Rory with an admissions interview that makes the school suddenly feel plausible.

s03e09.description: Lorelai and Rory attempt four Thanksgiving dinners in one day, culminating in Lorelai learning that Rory applied to Yale, while Lane and Dave finally kiss.

s03e10.description: Trix announces plans to move back near Richard and Emily, Rory battles Francie over student council politics, and renewed friendship with Dean makes Jess openly suspicious.

s03e11.description: Lorelai is dragged into Emily’s wrongful-termination lawsuit, while Francie manipulates Paris into believing Rory betrayed her and fractures their friendship at Chilton.

s03e12.description: Lorelai learns to fish for a date with Alex, Luke becomes interested in Nicole, and Paris’s attempt to remove Rory from student council ends when Headmaster Charleston intervenes.

s03e13.description: Sherry goes into labor with Lorelai and Rory at her side, prompting Lorelai to remember her own pregnancy and Rory’s birth while Christopher arrives at the last moment.

s03e14.description: Jess’s unexplained black eye turns Friday dinner into a disaster and sparks his first serious argument with Rory, leaving Luke to help the new couple repair the damage.

s03e15.description: Rory tires of Jess’s casual attitude toward making plans and goes to a hockey game without him, where she discovers Dean has begun dating Lindsay.

s03e16.description: Paris collapses after sleeping with Jamie and then being rejected by Harvard, while Rory receives her college acceptances, Sookie learns she is pregnant and Lorelai reconnects with Max.

s03e17.description: A fire closes the Independence Inn and scatters its guests across Stars Hollow, while Rory chooses Yale and Luke discovers that Jess has been skipping school to work excessive hours.

s03e18.description: Richard gives Lorelai the proceeds from an old investment, allowing her to repay Rory’s Chilton tuition but convincing Emily that Friday dinners may disappear with the debt.

s03e19.description: Lane’s band plays its first party and her drunken phone call exposes her secrets to Mrs. Kim, while Jess’s school failure and treatment of Rory culminate in a violent fight with Dean.

s03e20.description: Fran’s death gives Lorelai and Sookie a chance to pursue the Dragonfly Inn, Dean announces his engagement to Lindsay, and Jess’s estranged father arrives in Stars Hollow.

s03e21.description: Jess abruptly leaves Stars Hollow for Venice, California, to confront the father who abandoned him, while Rory remains focused on finals and graduation without knowing he has gone.

s03e22.description: Rory arranges a new loan from Emily and Richard to fund Yale, freeing Lorelai to pursue the Dragonfly Inn, then graduates from Chilton as Jess makes silent contact from California.
